title: dumpcap: don't pass around a pointer to global_ld.
description:
We do not have more than one loop_data structure. Just refer directly
to the global structure; that makes it clearer that there's only one.
(We were already doing that in capture_loop_write_packet_cb(), as it's a
pcap_dispatch() callback, and we were passing it a pointer to a
per-interface structure as its one and only user-data argument.)
